messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 1-ethyl-4-iodobenzene with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

picks.reason: Tests the untried ethyl isoxazole-3-carboxylate under the best-performing ligand/base conditions; its previous result was confounded by a different ligand and base.
Tests the positional isomer ethyl isoxazole-4-carboxylate under the best-performing conditions to assess the effect of carboxylate position.
Evaluates the 4-carboxylate isomer of a methyl-substituted isoxazole, given the strong results for related carboxylated additives.
Tests a simpler methyl isoxazole-5-carboxylate to determine whether the ester-bearing additive motif remains effective without additional ring substitution.
Checks whether L2's strong performance with A13 extends to the second-best tested additive, A9, while retaining the best-performing base.
